answer: The cheapest real defence: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because meadow only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, zenith is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any sable approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
